items.title: Criminal Minds
items.summary: Criminal Minds revolves around an elite team of FBI profilers who analyze the country's most twisted criminal minds, anticipating their next moves before they strike again.

items.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
items.summary: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds follows Captain Pike, Science Officer Spock and Number One in the decade before Captain Kirk boarded the U.S.S. Enterprise , as they explore new worlds around the galaxy .

items.title: Silo
items.summary: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo .

items.title: Sugar
items.summary: John Sugar is an American private investigator on the heels of the mysterious disappearance of Olivia Siegel, the beloved granddaughter of legendary Hollywood producer Jonathan Siegel. As Sugar tries to determine what happened to Olivia, he will also unearth Siegel family secrets; some very recent, others long-buried.

items.title: Granite Harbour
items.summary: Granite Harbour centres on the story of Lance Corporal Davis Lindo who arrives in Aberdeen as a new recruit to Police Scotland. Having completed his final tour with the Royal Military Police, Lindo dreams of being a detective at New Scotland Yard. However, he finds himself being sent to train as a Detective Constable in the North East of Scotland, he must quickly adapt to his new life in Aberdeen, a world away from anything this soldier has known before. Lindo finds an ally in his mentor, DCI Tara ‘Bart' Bartlett, a razor-sharp, streetwise Aberdonian who is used to going solo. Together, this unlikely partnership must navigate the choppy waters of their first case – the murder of one of Aberdeen's most recognisable faces from the Oil Industry. Suddenly, Lindo and Bartlett find themselves thrust into a corporate battle between old and new energy.

items.title: Ransom Canyon
items.summary: Ransom Canyon is a romance-fueled family drama and contemporary western saga that charts the intersecting lives of three ranching families, all set against the rugged expanse of Texas Hill Country.

items.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
items.summary: Set in the future, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon, Leonard and Howard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert, and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke. Along the way, they meet alternate-universe versions of characters we've come to know and love from The Big Bang Theory. As the title implies, things don't go well.

items.title: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon
items.summary: Emmy Award and Grammy Award winner Jimmy Fallon brought NBC's "The Tonight Show" back to its New York origins when he launched The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon from Rockefeller Center. Fallon puts his own stamp on the storied NBC late-night franchise with his unique comedic wit, on-point pop culture awareness, welcoming style and impeccable taste in music with the award-winning house band, The Roots.

items.title: The Chi
items.summary: The Chi is a timely coming-of-age story centering on a group of residents who become linked by coincidence but bonded by the need for connection and redemption. Kevin is the pre-teen who must step past shattered illusions and embrace the normal rites of childhood, while Brandon the dreamer makes his own nearly impossible leap of faith to succeed in life and love with girlfriend Jerrika. Emmett is the carefree teen is thrust into complex responsibility with guidance from his mother Jada, and Ronnie is the drifter whose struggle to love and be loved calls into question his every pursuit.

items.title: Heartstopper
items.summary: Heartstopper tells the story of Nick and Charlie, two British teens at an all-boys grammar school. Charlie, a highly-strung, openly gay over-thinker, and Nick, a cheerful, soft-hearted rugby player, who one day are made to sit together.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.summary: A storm is coming for happily married attorneys Anna and Tom Bowden when Max Cady, the notorious killer they are responsible for putting behind bars, is let out of prison - and he wants vengeance.

items.title: Married at First Sight
items.summary: Married at First Sight is an extreme social experiment that follows six brave singles yearning for a life-long partnership as they agree to a provocative proposal: getting legally married to a complete stranger the moment they first meet. Four specialists – sexologist, Dr. Logan Levkoff; psychologist, Dr. Joseph Cilona; sociologist, Dr. Pepper Schwartz; and spiritual advisor, Greg Epstein – create what they believe are three perfect couples, based on scientific matchmaking. The couples will not meet until they walk down the aisle and see each other face-to-face, for the first time, at the altar. Over the course of several weeks, episodes capture each couple's journey as they go from wedding, to honeymoon, to early nesting, to the daily struggle of working on their marriage. After several weeks together, each couple must make a decision: do they remain together or decide to divorce?

items.title: EastEnders
items.summary: Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

items.title: Days of Our Lives
items.summary: Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama. Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

items.title: Casualty
items.summary: They're fighting to save patients while their personal lives are brimming with drama and intrigue. Everything's at stake on the emergency ward.

items.title: Hot Ones
items.summary: The show with hot questions and even hotter wings.

items.title: Emmerdale
items.summary: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

items.title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
items.summary: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he's reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!

items.title: Breaking Bear
items.summary: A family of bears run a drug empire to raise money to save their forest from frackers and an endless array of psychotic enemies.

items.title: Proud
items.summary: The story of Filip, a young and irresponsible gay man who lives with the conviction that the world belongs to him and that this will never change. He is brazen, unpunished, thoughtless, impatient, beautiful, and young. He compensates for his inner lack of self-confidence with arrogance, admiration in others' eyes, and a job as a model. When a family tragedy strikes, his entire world is turned upside down.

items.title: Tales of Demons and Gods
items.summary: Killed by a Sage Emperor and reborn as his 13 year old self, Nie Li was given a second chance at life. A second chance to change everything and save his loved ones and his beloved city. He shall once again battle with the Sage Emperor to avenge his death and those of his beloved . With the vast knowledge of hundred years of life he accumulated in his previous life, wielding the strongest demon spirits, he shall reach the pinnacle of Martial Arts. Enmities of the past will be settled in this new lifetime. "Since I'm back, then in this lifetime, I shall become the King of the Gods that dominate everything. Let everything else tremble beneath my feet!"

items.title: Wanmei Shijie
items.summary: Born into a unique world where villages fight to gain power and control, the main character, Shi Hao, is a genius blessed by the heavens born under the poorest conditions. His clan, however, has a mysterious past. To rise and become the genius he is meant to be, the clan goes through every effort to aid his cultivation as they battle through fanatical monsters and engage in power struggles with other clans. His journey will bring him through unknown lands until he can become a person that can truly shake the world.

items.title: Drag Race France
items.summary: Nicky Doll, the most famous and international of French drag queens, puts on RuPaul's heels and takes over the controls of Drag Race France , for an eventful first season! At her side, an exceptional duo to find THE best French drag queen: DJ and singer Kiddy Smile, icon of the ballroom and voguing scene, and Daphné Bürki, emblematic face of France Télévision, actress and stylist by training. To help them, each week, prestigious guests from the world of French culture invite themselves into the competition. Through mini and maxi challenges, parades and legendary lipsyncs, the 10 queens compete in talents from all areas: fashion, music, humour..., because only one will be the queen.

items.title: I Became a Legend after My 10 Year-Long Last Stand.
items.summary: With no other options, Luck makes the choice to hold the line against the unending demonic hordes alone, to make sure his comrades can escape with their lives. However, through a combination of fortune, skill, and ingenuity, he holds that line for ten straight years, eventually coming out on top singlehandedly. Now he has to tackle the dilemma of how to occupy himself in a world where he holds a myriad of roles: that of a legend, that of a veteran, and that of a brand new face.

items.title: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars
items.summary: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars welcomes back queens with unfinished business to compete for the chance to be crowned "Canada's Ultimate All-Star," and win a cash prize of $100,000.

items.title: Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan Zhi Fanren Feng Qi Tian Nan
items.summary: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

items.title: Blades of the Guardians
items.summary: The story takes place during the Sui dynasty. We follow the journey of Dao Ma, an experienced bounty hunter, accompanied by his young son Xiao Qi.

items.title: Arafta
items.summary: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

items.title: Drag Race Down Under vs The World
items.summary: For the first time in Drag Race history, queens from across the globe will battle it out with Down Under's fiercest alumni for international drag supremacy. Drag Race Down Under vs The World will see fan-favourites from four seasons of Drag Race Down Under go head-to-head with sickening queens from around the world — all vying for the ultimate crown. The series will deliver a fresh global twist on the classic Drag Race format and a star studded guest judge line up. Get ready for new looks, louder drama, and legendary lip-syncs as the battle for global drag dominance begins.

items.title: Wan Jie Du Zun
items.summary: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

items.title: Smartypants
items.summary: The greatest thinkers/comedians of our time ask the questions no one else will.

items.title: Soul Land 2: The Unrivaled Tang Sect
items.summary: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?

items.title: The Idaho Murders: A College Town Nightmare
items.summary: In the fall of 2022, four University of Idaho students were found murdered in an off-campus house in the quiet college town of Moscow. As fear spread through the community, investigators faced intense pressure to solve a case marked by few immediate answers. This new documentary unpacks the chilling crime, the investigation that followed, and the lasting impact on a town forever changed.

items.title: The Great Ruler
items.summary: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

items.title: WWE Main Event
items.summary: WWE Main Event is a professional wrestling television program produced by WWE that originally aired on Ion Television in the United States and it originally aired on the WWE Network now airing on Hulu.

items.title: Parlor Room
items.summary: Host Becca Scott gathers her comedian friends for a game night like no other.

items.title: Against the Sky Supreme
items.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

items.title: Cang Yuan Tu
items.summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

items.title: Don't Be Too Emotional
items.summary: Jane Patrick is a mysterious young man with a dangerously captivating charm who can make any wish come true, as long as you agree to a non-negotiable exchange. Because of that, no one dares get close to him. But Jane Jennalee, a handsome young football player, boldly approaches Jane Patrick to ask for his ball back without the slightest fear. That moment becomes the starting point of their connection. Friends constantly warn Jane Jennalee that Jane Patrick is dangerous, and he must never ask him for anything. However, Jane Jennalee feels that this man is actually gentle and kind. As their relationship deepens, Jennalee begins to see another side of him, leaving him unable to stop wondering who Jane Patrick truly is.

items.title: Kaulitz & Kaulitz
items.summary: Bill and Tom Kaulitz bring us close to their life as Tokio Hotel frontmen, podcast hosts and close-knit twins, and to the highs and lows of fame.

items.title: Be My Player Two
items.summary: Thi (aka Thr33Gamer), a famous streamer, has to recruit Zo (aka Derya MK12), an unknown gamer who once embarrassed him during a live stream, to join his team, the "BS Brothers". From a clumsy rival, he becomes Thi's trusted No. 1 support. From a goal of just winning the championship, to a mission to win his heart as the prize.

items.title: Legend of Xianwu
items.summary: Exiled from his sect and left homeless, Ye Chen, a discarded disciple, stumbles upon a fortuitous encounter: the acquisition of true fire. With this newfound power, he sets foot once again on the path of cultivation. In this world where gods, demons, immortals, and Buddhas coexist, and amidst the chaos of countless realms, Ye Chen embarks on an extraordinary journey defying the heavens. Through hardships and reincarnations, he ultimately ascends to the pinnacle of the Great Dao.

items.title: Tomb of Fallen Gods
items.summary: Shenmo Cemetery, resting place of ancient Gods and Demons. An inconspicuous grave, surrounded by the tombs of giants, lies at the side. Suddenly, a young man emerges from the grave. Chen Nan, who had last felt the embrace of death, finds himself surrounded by the graves of Deities whose names shook the old Xiuhuan and Mohuan Continents. What happened to them? Why was he buried here as well? He finds that ten thousand years has passed, and the world has changed much in the meantime.

items.title: Deep In
items.summary: Fresh off winning Best Actor, Chen Xin finds himself cast alongside ambitious newcomer Zhang Zhun in a daring LGBTQ+ film. On screen, they portray psychiatrist Fang Chi and his patient Gao Zhun, whose relationship spirals beyond therapy into a dangerous mix of desire, obsession, and love. Off camera, Chen Xin and Zhang Zhun begin to lose sight of where acting ends and real feelings begin.

items.title: Редакция
items.summary: The author's journalistic program of Alexey Pivovarov, where he asks questions and interviews guests, makes reports on actual themes, as well as on entertaining topics.

items.title: Blossoms of Power
items.summary: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

items.title: The Prosecutor's Office's Proposal
items.summary: From the director of ‘Secret Relationships', follows the romance between an investigator burdened by the stigma of "being a murderer's son" and a prosecutor.

items.title: Lian Qi Shi Wan Nian
items.summary: No overview is available yet.

items.title: Love in Sync
items.summary: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

items.title: When Light Fades
items.summary: Early dawn, October 6, 1976. Amidst the roaring gunfire and explosions echoing across the university campus, Rawin and his friends lost everything in the blink of an eye. Left with no choice, he stepped onto a path of no return. Rawin chose to abandon his comfortable life and disregard his mother's desperate pleas, venturing deep into the dense jungle toward a land of shared ideology with his comrades. Within the dark and perilous wilderness, fate brought him face-to-face with Comrade Yue, a calm and cold-hearted young fighter who saved Rawin's life from a deadly animal trap just in the nick of time. Surrounded by exhausting hardships and the heavy weight of their ideals, an unspoken feeling quietly began to form between them—like a faint starlight still shining through the darkest night. And perhaps... on the road to "Baan Saeng Dao." This is the beginning of a journey that is not just a battle for their ideals, but a story of a deep bond slowly forging under the starlight.

items.title: Nurse the Dead
items.summary: Nurse the Dead follows Noa Reyes, a driven Filipina nurse supervisor whose ability to see ghosts — referred to as her "third eye" — makes her the go-to handler for a hospital ward teeming with restless spirits. Juggling demanding apparitions alongside staff burnout, family pressures and a coworker who seems to know more about her than expected, the series grounds its supernatural premise in the cultural specificity of the Filipino healthcare experience.

items.title: Hanzaisha
items.summary: Following the sole survivor of a random mass stabbing who is given a mysterious 10-day ultimatum to live, three unlikely allies—a determined detective, an investigative reporter, and the targeted survivor—risk everything to unravel the truth behind a shocking conspiracy hiding in the dark heart of Japanese society.

items.title: Overdo
items.summary: "Overdo" tells the story of Murong Qingyi, the youngest son of a warlord family in Republican-era Shanghai, who suffers abuse from his adoptive father after being switched at birth. When he escapes as a young man, he is saved by Ren Susu, but his involvement brings disaster upon her family, causing its downfall. Years later, the two reunite and secretly develop feelings for each other, yet Ren Susu resolutely fakes her death and disappears to save others, leaving Murong Qingyi to sink into the pain of losing love. Three years later, Ren Susu returns, only to become Murong Qingyi's future sister-in-law. Now, one carries deep resentment from betrayal, while the other hides an indescribable pain. Between suspicion and struggle, their love and hatred become intertwined. As misunderstandings are gradually cleared and their love reignites, a national crisis arrives. With the determination to face death in their fight against enemies, where will the fate of Murong Qingyi and Ren Susu lead?

items.title: GMA3
items.summary: GMA3 is a news, health, lifestyle and shopping program.

items.title: Sin and Love
items.summary: Police, drug lords, undercover agents, and spies—all layers of the power system are collapsing. Behind a seemingly lawful police hierarchy lies a city controlled by corruption, desire, and hidden power games, where human lives are only bargaining chips. A mysterious kidnapping exposes a buried network of crimes, unraveling misaligned identities, systemic corruption, and a long-suppressed past. Love and sex become tools of control and exchange. And the real chaos began ten years ago, within a forgotten relationship that never truly ended.

items.title: My Lady's Bodyguard
items.summary: Disguise might be able to hide the truth, but it can never hide the feelings born within the heart. When a female bodyguard must protect a mischievous young lady who is the light of her life - how will this love story end?

items.title: Today 3rd Hour
items.summary: A news program intended to inform, entertain, inspire and set the agenda each morning. Each daily live broadcast provides current domestic and international news, weather reports, and interviews with newsmakers from the worlds of politics, business, media, entertainment and sports.

items.title: Bittersweet Love
items.summary: Born into poverty in a rural village, Lu Xiaofan unexpectedly enters an elite family in the capital as the live-in son-in-law of a powerful official's household. He once believed this marriage would change his life, only to discover that he is merely a tool used to cover up a family secret. In this unfamiliar and ruthless world, the only person willing to reach out to him is his wife's older brother, Bei Luqing. One is a young man from the bottom, desperately trying to rise above his fate; the other is a cold, handsome golden boy standing at the top. But what happens when they both fall for the one person they should never love?

items.title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
items.summary: At the peak of his career, top celebrity Feng Qinglang escapes to a remote tea mountain, seeking a brief respite from the spotlight. Instead, he meets Xu Changyang, a free-spirited young tea farmer with an untamed soul. One belongs to the dazzling world of fame, the other to the forests and the land. As they grow closer among the mountains and wilderness, love quietly takes root. But the relentless scrutiny of the entertainment industry and the harsh realities of society soon close in, pushing them toward separation time and again. In the end, will they follow the call of their hearts and risk everything for love?

items.title: Woeste Grond
items.summary: Three generations of the Ottink family work together on one farm. Each has a different vision for the future of their beloved dairy farm. Woeste Grond shows the emotional and recognizable dynamics of a farming family balancing tradition and modernity.

items.title: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
items.summary: In a dysfunctional Delhi Government School, a laidback headmaster's attempt at a fully paid Cambridge trip sparks a chaotic makeover attempt - forcing a ragtag team of teachers to fix the broken system, one blackboard lesson at a time.

items.title: Shixiong A Shixiong
items.summary: After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator. To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities. Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

items.title: Stand BI Me
items.summary: The show focuses on contestants navigating attraction regardless of gender, promising high-stakes drama, secret voting, and strategic romance.

items.title: Noona, You Are a Woman to Me
items.summary: No overview is available yet.

items.title: SolarBalls
items.summary: What if we could see the universe from a different perspective? If we weren't limited by Earth's gravity and could just fly through space and see planets up close? Well... we'll probably freak out when we notice they have a face!

items.title: Ekstrem gjemsel
items.summary: In " Ekstrem gjemsel ", 15 celebrities will compete in an extreme game of hide and seek. Presenter Victor Sotberg has his fellow presenters Christopher Omdahl and Robin Hofset with him, and together they will hunt down the participants who will be tasked with hiding as best as possible so as not to be found.

items.title: NBC News Daily
items.summary: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

items.title: Yagami Eiko: Ueno Chuo Police Station Organized Crime Countermeasures Division
items.summary: Set in the culturally diverse Ueno district of Tokyo, the story follows Eiko Yagami, a beautiful and dangerous detective in the Organized Crime Countermeasures Division (colloquially known as "Marubo"). Breaking all the rules, Yagami doesn't hesitate to use violence or ally with the Yakuza and the Chinese mafia. Her ultimate, driving goal is to uncover the truth behind the murder of her husband—a freelance journalist who dug too deep into the criminal underworld.

items.title: Sunny Bunnies
items.summary: The series focuses on 5 colored bunnies (Turbo, Big Boo, Iris, Shiny and Hopper). They are usually in Sunny Park and always have an adventure.

items.title: Zhan Shen: Fanchen Shenyu
items.summary: The story follows Lin Qiye, a young man who navigates a society seemingly protected by gods, only to discover that ancient deities and monsters actually pose an active threat to humanity. To protect his city, he joins the "Night Watchmen"—an elite, secret organization of superpowered individuals who battle mythological threats. [1, 2, 3]

items.title: Холод
items.summary: Zhenya is unjustly imprisoned for a car accident on Kutuzovsky Prospekt, in which her husband and 6-year-old daughter are killed. The real culprits of the accident are rich kids whose powerful parents "help" the court make the "right" decision. In the penal colony, Zhenya accidentally saves an influential inmate, Yana, who is serving a sentence for murder. In gratitude, Yana teaches Zhenya how to become stronger in order to take revenge, and helps her escape. Once free, Zhenya gains wealth through Yana's guidance and begins to seek justice against her enemies.

items.title: WWE Lucha Libre AAA
items.summary: WWE Lucha Libre AAA highlights their partnership, blending WWE's global reach with AAA's rich Mexican tradition, focusing on shared talent like Rey Mysterio and Dominik Mysterio in explosive crossover events like Worlds Collide and TripleMania , showcasing vibrant lucha libre action for new audiences worldwide.

items.title: Zantiis
items.summary: Sila, a sharp and meticulous young CEO suffering from severe burnout and chronic insomnia, decides to go undercover to inspect his property, Zantiis Ndol Villas. Using the alias "Kin," he hopes to find some rest while secretly evaluating his staff. However, chaos ensues during the High Season when a system glitch causes his reserved room to be double-booked. Tonnam, a dedicated receptionist who lives by the motto "The Guest is God," refuses to turn the other guests away. Seeing how exhausted "Kin" looks, Tonnam offers his own accommodation—a wooden staff house by the stream—as a temporary solution, but on one condition: they must share the room. Amidst the cozy space, the soothing sounds of Muak Lek Waterfall, and Tonnam's cheerful energy, the once-cold and sleepless Sila discovers that this simple life is the perfect cure for his insomnia. He soon finds himself addicted to his new life as "Kin"—and to being the roommate of this charming receptionist.

items.title: 10 NEWS+
items.summary: 10 NEWS+ will follow Network 10's 5pm local news bulletins across the country, offering viewers extended context and deeper reporting on the day's biggest stories. The 5pm bulletin remains a cornerstone of the network's trusted news offering, delivering the latest breaking news and updates. 10 NEWS+ aims to redefine evening news by providing comprehensive analysis, trusted reporting, and long-form investigative journalism. The program will offer a fresh perspective on critical local and global stories, tailored for an engaged audience seeking in-depth news coverage. At a time when misinformation is rife, 10 NEWS+ is steadfast in its commitment to truth and transparency, delivering journalism with integrity, clarity, and purpose. Designed for Australia's evolving media landscape, 10 NEWS+ will integrate across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, ensuring content is accessible and engaging for Australians everywhere. The program will be anchored Sunday to Thursday by investigative journalist Denham Hitchcock and Walkley Award-winning journalist Amelia Brace, with Senior Journalist and respected news anchor Ursula Heger and National Affairs Editor Hugh Riminton leading coverage every Friday.

items.title: Bovensloters
items.summary: A crime series set in Brabant. Jamie, an anthropologist from Utrecht, has her life together until she finds herself caught up in the Brabant underworld. Together with the shrewd Petra, she discovers a new side of Brabant and of herself.

items.title: Похищение
items.summary: MVD Captain Aglaia Mezentseva and investigator Vsevolod Kosinsky, one of the best specialists in child abduction cases, are unraveling the case of the missing 5-year-old grandson of world-renowned conductor Mark Kretchetov. The child mysteriously disappeared during a walk with his nanny, and the woman herself was hit on the head and lost her memory. Literally all members of the Kretchetov family fall under suspicion, and Kosinsky spares no one in his pursuit of results. Aglaia disapproves of Kosinsky's methods, but nevertheless becomes his best student. The more Aglaia untangles the web of complex family relationships and financial machinations within the Kretchetov family, the more she has to sacrifice – her peace of mind, her career, the lives and feelings of others. And even put her unborn child at risk.

items.title: Late Night with Seth Meyers: Corrections
items.summary: Online short-form series with host Seth correcting the week's stories and arguing with YouTube commenters.

items.title: Ling Wu Dalu
items.summary: No overview is available yet.

items.title: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia
items.summary: The series introduces a new generation of young fans to the iconic world of Masters of the Universe through fast-paced, action-packed mini adventures. Tales from Eternia delivers high-stakes clashes between He-Man, Skeletor, and Eternia's iconic heroes and villains, bringing the timeless conflict between good and evil to life for today's audiences.

items.title: Yiran's Silver Linings
items.summary: Li Yiran returns to Lecang, a small town in the southwest. Eight years apart have driven a wedge between Li Yiran and her mom. By a twist of fate, the two find themselves taking charge of the town's "life's major events." As they face one heartbreaking yet heartwarming story after another, Li Yiran begins to see life and regret in a new light. And quietly, her relationship with her mom starts to shift...

items.title: The Shadow Sovereign
items.summary: Princess Zhao Yang, Li Shu, is born to a low-ranking concubine and grows up in the Cold Palace, where she endures years of neglect because of her mother's humble status. Through her intelligence and political acumen, she earns a place in the Crown Prince's faction. Yet after leaving the Cold Palace, she becomes nothing more than a pawn in his political game. Three years later, Emperor Bing Qian reforms the imperial examination system by reviving the Xiao Lian recommendation system to curb the influence of the powerful noble clans. At the banquet honoring the newly crowned scholars, Li Shu is publicly impeached by Shen Xiao, the top scholar from a humble background. With the emperor quietly orchestrating events behind the scenes, Shen Xiao leads the rising commoner officials in challenging the aristocratic families and their monopoly on power. As Li Shu and Shen Xiao confront each other, they become locked in a fierce political rivalry. Determined to break free from her loveless marriage and the Crown Prince's control, Li Shu uses her public clashes with Shen Xiao as a cover while secretly cultivating the influence of talented commoners. Together, they gradually weaken the corrupt Crown Prince's faction and reshape the empire's balance of power.

items.title: Karna The Guardian
items.summary: Karna lives as an ordinary boy—until the ancient demon Kalimba breaks free and spreads corruption across the world. When the darkness infects his mother, Karna's powers awaken, revealing his true identity: the Balancer, a Guardian born to restore harmony to the world. To save his mother and stop Kalimba's chaos, Karna must train to master the power within him—or risk losing everything.

items.title: De Oranjezomer
items.summary: Hélène Hendriks discusses with her guests their perspectives on the news and current events surrounding major sporting events, politics, the entertainment industry, and more.

items.title: Фейк
items.summary: Lyceum teacher Rita begins to be stalked online. The stalker hits her where it hurts: work, students, family, and self-confidence. Rita tries to understand: who is this person and what does he want? But there are too many people around her who would like to turn her life into a nightmare.

items.title: Oppdrag Europa
items.summary: Mikkel and Herman solve assignments in some of Europe's least visited countries. On the way, they take part in a soap opera, tackle a spitting llama and meet baby Hitler!

items.title: Great Escape
items.summary: No overview is available yet.

items.title: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
items.summary: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

items.title: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss
items.summary: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she's about to enter.

items.title: TFI Unplugged
items.summary: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.

items.title: World Wonder Ring STARDOM
items.summary: World Wonder Ring Stardom , legal name Kabushiki Gaisha Stardom (株式会社スターダム Kabushiki Gaisha Sutādamu) and often referred to simply as Stardom (stylized as STARD✪M),[2] is a Japanese joshi puroresu or women's professional wrestling promotion, founded in September 2010 by former Hyper Visual Fighting Arsion and JDStar promoter Rossy Ogawa, retired wrestler, model and mixed martial artist Fuka Kakimoto and veteran professional wrestler Nanae Takahashi. Stardom quickly became one of the top joshi puroresu promotions, largely thanks to gravure idol Yuzuki Aikawa becoming the promotion's public face.

items.title: ABC News Live Weekend
items.summary: ABC News Live Weekend will feature the biggest stories of the week with all the facts and analysis viewers need to reflect on global events and prepare for what's coming next.

items.title: The Forbidden Land
items.summary: Spring at Qiongzhou University is shattered when Li Weihao, a design student, leaps to his death. Rejected by the girl he loved, tormented by relentless campus bullying, betrayed by his parents, and stripped of his dreams, he chooses to end his life. His death becomes a mirror, exposing the darkest secrets hidden within everyone around him. His childhood friend Zhang Chao is forced to confront long-buried trauma, triggering the emergence of a ten-year-old alternate personality within him. Psychologist Chen Rong, haunted by guilt over failing to respond to Li Weihao's desperate plea for help in time, joins the investigation. Bai Qiu, the girl Li secretly loved, risks infiltrating influencer Zhu Xiaoyu's illegal trafficking network to uncover the truth behind her best friend Shasha's suspicious car crash. Meanwhile, former bully Lin Jiaming struggles under the oppressive control of his authoritarian father, Lin Yongtai. As the investigation unfolds, a web of campus bullying, corruption, sexual exploitation, and drug-facilitated assaults is gradually brought to light, all leading to the vast criminal empire secretly orchestrated by billionaire Lin Yongtai.

items.title: Come Dine with Me: Celebrity Philippines
items.summary: A group of celebrities take turns hosting their own dinner parties and grading each other. Over the week they battle for the title of best host, and the chance to win a grand cash prize for their chosen charity.

items.title: BattleBots Pro League
items.summary: BattleBots Pro League powered by Bright Data is the toughest robot combat event on the planet. 24 elite bots from across the globe converge on Las Vegas for the ultimate fight to the death. There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.

items.title: Snapping Golden Bough
items.summary: Amid fierce court rivalries in the Great Wei Dynasty, Shen Suhe is forced to marry the Second Prince, enduring humiliation before losing her family and life. Reborn on her wedding day, she pretends to be foolish to uncover the truth, joining forces with Prince Yu, Mu Yunzheng, to clear the injustice, defeat the Empress and the Fourth Prince, and eventually live in seclusion together.

items.title: Jiang Ye
items.summary: After traveling to what appears to be a true Tang Dynasty world, the main character Ning Que discovers that it is actually a perilous agricultural world. He first believed that he could become superior and live a luxurious lifestyle, but he discovers that he lacks cultivation skills. He was also persecuted for thousands of miles and saw his entire family massacred when he was four years old. He discovered the baby Sangsang while he was running away from death and picked up a black umbrella in a sea of blood and dead. He discovered the will to live in despair. He takes the large black umbrella and Sangsang and launches an exciting counterattack, refusing to submit to fate.

items.title: CNN This Morning
items.summary: Start your day with Audie Cornish bringing you the latest headlines and analysis.

items.title: Alliance
items.summary: Alliance is a competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points - the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

items.title: Mrs. Revenge
items.summary: No overview is available yet.

items.title: Unsettled Case
items.summary: One cold case per unit, two units per season. The debut season of Unsettled Case focuses on two units: "The Jewelry Store Serial Robbery" and "The Bianji Hotel Robbery." Within a time rift that moves against the grain, it deconstructs how crime reshapes a person, while also telling a story of how faith can redeem a soul.
